title: How to make $5k / month creating content WITHOUT followers
summary: A UGC creator explains making paid ad content for brands without followers: portfolio, pitching, rates, retainers and delivery.

assertions.quote: I decided to try out UDC and in that first month I made over $7,000 part-time
Brands will use that content and they pay you directly for that content
you can also put yourself on monthly retainers so that Brands will hire you month after month for a set of videos

verdicts.note: Retainers exist for established creators, but brands increasingly pay per asset or on performance and beginners rarely get them.

assertions.quote: filming a brand deal for me usually takes about 1 to 2 hours and then another 1 to 2 hours to edit
